subject: FinTechCo - Dedicated capacity sizing call scheduling
messages:
From: Alice Tran <alice.tran@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eng Team <eng@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — really helpful to walk through Redwood’s serving model and how dedicated capacity maps to predictable throughput. We’d like to move to a technical deep dive / capacity sizing session next so our infra and ML engineers can validate latencies and integration points.

High level requirements from our side:
- Expected peak generation throughput: ~50 requests/sec (burst to 120 for short windows)
- Typical prompt length: 300 tokens, average response 150 tokens
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for user-facing requests
- Data residency: US only; audit logs required

Can we schedule a 60-minute sizing call next week? Prefer Thursday 6/17 after 11am PT or Friday 6/18 morning. Also — can you share any pre-call template we can fill out (model types, concurrency, sample traffic shape)?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Tran
Head of ML Infrastructure, FinTechCo
alice.tran@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tran <alice.tran@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps

Hi Alice — great to meet you and thanks for the summary.

We can absolutely do a dedicated capacity sizing session. I’ve looped in Camila (solutions) and David (SE) who will own the technical walkthrough and throughput sizing. Attached is our dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx — if you can fill the highlighted fields (peak RPS, prompt/response token distributions, model family, and any concurrency constraints) that will speed the call.

Proposed slots (60 minutes):
- Thu 6/17 11:30am–12:30pm PT
- Thu 6/17 2:00pm–3:00pm PT
- Fri 6/18 9:00am–10:00am PT

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick introductions & goal alignment (5m)
2) Review FinTechCo traffic profile & perf targets (10m)
3) Redwood sizing methodology & dedicated capacity options (20m)
4) Throughput/latency calculations & kernel/quantization recommendations (15m)
5) Next steps / handoff to procurement (10m)

Do any of these slots work? If not, share a couple times and we’ll adapt. I’ll also drop a calendar hold once we lock a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: FT-4392_dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet with fields to populate: model family, avg prompt tokens, avg response tokens, expected requests/sec, burst RPS, concurrency, retention requirements)

From: Alice Tran <alice.tran@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eng Team <eng@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps

Marissa — thanks, that looks good. Friday 6/18 9:00am–10:00am PT works best for our engineers. I’ve attached a short perf summary (FinTechCo_perf_summary.pdf) and filled the template with the initial numbers — see the attachment.

One note: we expect daytime peak around 2000 users generating ~1.5 requests/min each during peak windows, so burst behavior is important. For models we’re evaluating a mix of open LLaMA variants and a smaller instruction-tuned model for short responses.

Please send the calendar invite and a Google Meet link.

—Alice

Attachment: FinTechCo_perf_summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tran <alice.tran@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps

Thanks Alice — confirmed for Fri 6/18 9:00am–10:00am PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=fintechco-sizing-20270618 (Google Meet included).

Attendees from Redwood: Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer) — will walk the sizing worksheet and kernel/quantization recommendations; David Kim (SE) — will review integration and latency guardrails; myself — notes and procurement handoff.

Pre-call ask: please paste the completed template into the shared Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SizingDocs) or attach to the calendar event. We’ll review your perf summary and come prepared with recommended dedicated GPU pool sizes and expected p95 latency estimates.

Next steps after the call: sizing doc & recommended capacity (1–2 business days), procurement checklist & draft term sheet.

Talk soon — Marissa
